meta.source: London Datastore: Noise Pollution in London (Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3 (Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector); rounded to 5 decimals by a hand rule; vertices closer than 2 m to the previous kept vertex dropped by a hand rule
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 2zwnk: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.
selection_notes: hand rule: Lden (day-evening-night) road and rail noise bands only, coordinates to 5 decimals (about 1 m), vertices closer than 2 m dropped; the LAeq16h and Lnight layers (20,000 more zone polygons, 15 MB in all) repeat the same contours for other periods; the 2018 maps (2017 data) are older than Defra round 4 (2022)
Road_Lden_London.zip: 4 polygons with over 1000 vertices cut to the zone box plus 500 m (clipped_to_zone)
